# GlidieBirdie — Canonical Project Context For AI Assistants

Read this file first before modifying the repository. `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc` all point here.

## Read Order

1. `README.md` — player features, quickstart, and 5-second axiom proof
2. `CLAIMS.md` & `LIMITATIONS.md` — falsifiable claims and honest boundaries
3. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` & `docs/architecture_master_blueprint.md` — acyclic 20-module ES2022 layout
4. `docs/build-standard.md` & `repo.yaml` — Build Standard v1.2.0 manifest
5. `lean/README.md` — 68 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 proofs (Palomar `Challenge`/`Solution` + 9 adversarial refutations)
6. `.memory/security.md` & `docs/threat-model.md` — storage, CSP, and HTTP server boundaries

## What This Project Is

GlidieBirdie (`v3.2.0`) is a solo-built, browser-first, zero-runtime-dependency calm arcade flyer engineered with:

- one semantic HTML shell (`index.html`)
- one layered stylesheet (`style.css`)
- 20 native ES2022 modules under `src/` (`src/main.js`, 18 runtime modules, and `src/index.js` headless barrel) loaded by `game.js` (zero bundler, zero runtime npm deps)
- one compact offline app-shell service worker (`service-worker.js`)
- 68 machine-checked pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`lean/`, zero Mathlib, Palomar `Challenge.lean`/`Solution.lean`, 6 kernels + live negative tamper test)
- an offline C11 differential oracle & 1,000,000-case fuzzer (`native/glidiebirdie_oracle.c`, `tests/native-differential.mjs`) plus Zig/WASM microbenchmark companion (`native/oracle.zig`)
- an AMS-LaTeX Build White Paper (`paper/main.tex` -> `dist/Donahue_2026_glidiebirdie_deterministic_browser_architecture.pdf`)

## Hard Rules

- Do not add a build step or bundler for the browser game.
- Do not add runtime dependencies (`package.json` `dependencies` stays absent; dev-only tooling runs offline/CI).
- Do not add remote assets, hosted fonts, analytics, or CDN imports.
- Do not add a backend or network data flow for gameplay state.
- Do not split `style.css` into multiple files.
- Keep `service-worker.js` tiny and app-shell-focused; keep `CACHE_NAME` locked to `VERSION` and `package.json`.
- `.gitignore` policy: ignore only OS/editor junk, `node_modules/`, Playwright test output, and Build Standard / toolchain build directories (`lean/.lake/`, `paper/build/`, `_site/`). Never ignore `dist/` (frozen PDF and arXiv bundle are tracked).
- Never fabricate test results, axiom lines, benchmarks, peer review, DOIs, or LLC affiliation (`Alexander Stephen Donahue`, Independent Researcher, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`).
- Classify every audit finding as exactly one of: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.

## Runtime Rules

- Put tunable constants in `CONFIG` (`src/config.js`).
- Advance gameplay strictly via the 60 Hz fixed-step integrator quantized on the 720 Hz integer tick grid (`src/timestep.js`, `src/loop.js`).
- Route all persistence through guarded helpers in `src/storage.js` under the `gb:` namespace.
- Keep keyboard, pointer, mobile touch bar, and gamepad controls at parity.
- Preserve automated WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility across all interactive views, live screen-reader announcements, `prefers-reduced-motion`, and unlayered `prefers-reduced-transparency`.
- Build Standard v1.2.0 R1–R4: commit and push straight to `main` once owner disables legacy branch protection; CI is strictly informational, never a merge gate, and no Dependabot/CodeRabbit/Copilot/PR-template/guardrail-gate workflows are used. Never defeat or bypass active GitHub branch protection if still enabled on the remote.

## Verification Commands

```bash
npm run check          # syntax, static, brand, link, license, 12/12 citations, 81 engine, 8 property/contract, determinism, smoke
npm run fuzz           # 2,000-case adversarial parser & HTTP static-server fuzzer
npm run test:native    # C11 differential oracle (bit-for-bit parity + 1,000,000 fuzz cases)
npm run mutate         # baseline-gated 16/16 surgical mutation testing
npm run benchmark      # 30-seed counterbalanced 60/144 Hz + 5,400 pure-step + 5x10k pool benchmark -> results/benchmarks.json
npm run lint           # ESLint across src/, tests/, tools/, scripts/, examples/
npm run typecheck      # tsc via jsconfig.json + WebWorker service-worker.js
npm run test:browser   # 7 Playwright + 4-view axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA E2E tests
(cd lean && lake build && lake build Challenge && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean)
pwsh scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .
```

## Repository Map

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `game.js`, `src/*.js` | Native ES2022 browser engine (20 files: `main.js`, 18 runtime modules, `index.js` headless barrel) |
| `index.html`, `style.css`, `service-worker.js`, `manifest.webmanifest` | PWA shell, CSS Cascade Layers, offline cache |
| `lean/` | 68 pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`module`, zero Mathlib, Palomar `Challenge`/`Solution`, `comparator.json`, negative kernel tamper script) |
| `native/` | Offline C11 differential reference oracle + 1M fuzzer (`glidiebirdie_oracle.c`) & Zig/WASM benchmark (`oracle.zig`) |
| `paper/`, `dist/` | AMS-LaTeX Build White Paper, frozen PDF, standalone `arxiv_submission.tar.gz` |
| `tests/`, `scripts/` | Engine (81), determinism, property/metamorphic/HTTP contract, 2,000-case JS fuzzer, C11 oracle test, Playwright/axe, 16/16 mutation, benchmarks, citations, audit |
| `tools/` | Zero-dep `static-server.mjs` (strict public allowlist, IPv6-safe, `/healthz`, traversal/symlink defense) & `generate-icons.mjs` |
| `docs/`, `.memory/` | Architecture, ADRs, threat model, benchmarks, preregistration, reviews, run-log |

# GlidieBirdie

[![CI](https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Pages Deploy](https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie/actions/workflows/pages.yml/badge.svg)](https://0thernes.github.io/glidiebirdie/)
[![Canary](https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie/actions/workflows/post-deploy-canary.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie/actions/workflows/post-deploy-canary.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2f855a)](LICENSE.txt)
[![Project Status: Active](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#active)

**Status:** Active (`v3.2.0`) · **Build Standard:** `v1.2.0` (`repo.yaml`) · **Epistemic Scope:** Verified browser-game engineering build (not peer reviewed; retires `0 / 1,900` open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`).

A browser-first, one-tap arcade flyer tuned for comfort instead of punishment.

GlidieBirdie keeps the fast arcade loop, then softens the failure edges: slower pacing, gentler
physics, readable visuals, full mobile controls, procedural audio with reverb, a forgiving Feather
Shield, daily seeded runs, five living themes, 12 achievements, a Serene Postcard capture mode, and a
small offline-ready PWA shell. No build step, no runtime dependency, no remote asset requirement.
Serve it from any static host and glide.

[![Serene meadow golden-hour scene — the bird gliding peacefully between generous pipes in GlidieBirdie.](docs/assets/hero-calm-meadow.jpg)](https://0thernes.github.io/glidiebirdie/)

[Play the live demo](https://0thernes.github.io/glidiebirdie/) ·
[Build White Paper (PDF)](dist/Donahue_2026_glidiebirdie_deterministic_browser_architecture.pdf) ·
[Lean 4 Blueprint](blueprint/index.html) ·
[Claims Ledger](CLAIMS.md) ·
[Limitations](LIMITATIONS.md) ·
[Replication](REPLICATION.md) ·
[Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) ·
[Support](SUPPORT.md)

## Why It Feels Better

| Design goal | What GlidieBirdie does |
| --- | --- |
| Softer difficulty | Larger pipe gaps, slower travel, gentler gravity, slower terminal fall, circle hitbox. |
| Full mobile depth | On-screen Brake / Flap / Dive buttons on phones — full keyboard depth, no controls hidden. |
| More player expression | Hold Brake (or `Shift`), hold Dive (or `↓`), and tune physics in the Zen Customizer. |
| More delight | Meadow golden godrays + drifting pollen, five themes, reverb, ambient music, particle bursts, expressive bird emotions, cozy achievements, and Serene Postcard mode for shareable moments. |
| Less punishment | Feather Shield absorbs one collision and gives the bird a graceful recovery moment. |
| Better reliability | Fixed 60 Hz simulation with interpolation, so 60 Hz and 144 Hz displays share one trajectory. DPR-sharp canvas on Retina and 4K. |
| Better inclusion | Keyboard + skip-link, ARIA live updates, reduced-motion, reduced-transparency, forced-colors. |
| PWA-ready | Installable via Add-to-Home-Screen on iOS and Android. Offline app shell after first visit. |

## The Calm Philosophy

We kept the addictive loop everyone loves and removed everything that hurts. Larger gaps. Gentler
gravity. A shield that forgives. Five living themes you can feel in your chest. Procedural sound that
breathes with the world. A bird with real emotions and eyes that look for safety. No accounts. No ads.
No build step.

This is what happens when you treat "calm" as a design material, not a marketing word. It is a small,
solo, vibe-coded act of care: one HTML file, one CSS file, native ES modules in `src/`, zero runtime
dependencies, and a deep commitment to accessibility and reduced-motion respect.

## Features

- **Mobile control bar** — On-screen Brake / Flap / Dive on coarse-pointer devices.
- **PWA install + offline shell** — Add to Home Screen on iOS and Android via a real manifest and service worker.
- **DPR-sharp canvas** — Crisp on Retina, 2× / 3× phones, and 4K monitors.
- **Calm physics presets** — Tune gravity and speed from gentle to lively.
- **Daily Seed mode** — Deterministic pipe pattern by UTC date for friendly comparison.
- **Zen Customizer** — Physics sliders, audio volumes, theme picker, daily-seed toggle, FPS toggle, audio test, reset stats.
- **Five themes** — Sunset, Midnight, Cozy Rain, Aurora, and Meadow (golden-hour greens & warm sunlight), each changing colors, weather, and music.
- **Feather Shield** — A collectible bubble that absorbs one crash and grants brief invincibility.
- **Serene Postcard mode** — Pause into a calm frame and save a shareable PNG (`P` to enter, `C` to capture).
- **Expressive bird** — Calm, happy, scared, determined, and dizzy states with blush, smile, crest, and dizzy swirls.
- **Eye tracking** — Pupils track the nearest safe gap for a lively, readable character.
- **Procedural audio with reverb** — Web Audio creates every tone; convolution reverb gives real ambient space.
- **12 achievements** — From First Flight to Long Haul, each with live progress display.
- **Persistent stats** — Zen minutes, shields saved, runs, near misses, longest survival, current streak.
- **Tutorial overlay** — Shown once on first run; the dismiss button starts the first glide.
- **Fullscreen toggle** — `F` key or button.
- **Zero dependencies** — Pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No bundler, package install, CDN, or assets.

## Quick Start

### Open the game

Because the engine loads native ES modules (`<script type="module">`), browsers require HTTP(S) rather than `file://`. Start a tiny local static server:

```bash
node tools/static-server.mjs 8000
```

(Or `python -m http.server 8000` if you prefer Python.) Then visit `http://127.0.0.1:8000`.

### Run the checks

```bash
npm run check
```

That command needs no install. It syntax-checks every module, then runs static checks, brand/link/license guards, the engine tests (they import `src/`), the 60 Hz / 144 Hz determinism test, and the repo smoke test.

Lint, Playwright, and axe need the dev dependencies:

```bash
npm ci
npm run lint
npm run test:browser
```

A separate `npm run typecheck` runs ephemeral TypeScript over the `checkJs`-clean engine.

## Usage & Examples

### Run the deterministic simulation example

```bash
node examples/determinism_demo.mjs
```

### Run fuzzing, mutation testing, benchmarks, and Build Standard self-audit

```bash
npm run fuzz        # 2,000 adversarial parser & HTTP static-server fuzz cases
npm run test:native # C11 differential oracle (bit-for-bit parity + 1,000,000 fuzz cases)
npm run mutate      # baseline-gated 16/16 surgical mutants killed (100.0%)
npm run benchmark   # 30 counterbalanced paired seeds + 5,400 pure steps -> results/benchmarks.json
npm run audit       # Build Standard v1.2.0 audit via scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1
```

### Formal Verification — Exact Lean 4.35.0 Axiom Audit (5-Second Proof)

All **68 theorems** in [`lean/`](lean/README.md) (59 core + 9 constructive adversarial refutations; 19 zero-axiom) compile with zero Mathlib, zero `sorryAx`, zero `native_decide`, and zero custom axioms (`cd lean && lake build && lake build Challenge && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean && lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution`). Headline outputs from `VerifyAxioms.lean`:

```text
'GlidieBirdie.Timestep.lcm_60_144_eq_720' does not depend on any axioms
'GlidieBirdie.Timestep.steps_executed_no_drop_under_60_ticks' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Timestep.idle_scheduler_sleeps_when_hidden_or_static_pause' depends on axioms: [propext]
'GlidieBirdie.Collision.distSqPointRect_minimality' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Collision.circleHitsRect_monotone_radius' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Storage.dateSeedNat_injective' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Pools.listPoolClearAll_valid_and_restores' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Pools.fifoPush_length_bounded' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Physics.mulberry32_golden_20261125' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Physics.moving_pipe_lerp_within_bounds' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'GlidieBirdie.Adversarial.adversarial_detached_pupil_18_escapes_sclera' does not depend on any axioms
```

See the [Build White Paper](dist/Donahue_2026_glidiebirdie_deterministic_browser_architecture.pdf), [Interactive Blueprint](blueprint/index.html), [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md), [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md), and [`REPLICATION.md`](REPLICATION.md) for the complete statement-fidelity audit, 30-seed benchmarks, and clean-clone instructions.

## Limitations & Literal vs. Metaphor

See [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md) for full details. In summary, GlidieBirdie retires **0 / 1,900** open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`, is not peer reviewed, and separates literal engineering claims from creative/flavor terminology:

| Term in UI / Prose | Literal Reality |
| --- | --- |
| "60 Hz fixed-step on 720 Hz tick grid" | **Literal** — verified by Lean 4 (`TimestepGrid.lean`) and 30-seed paired benchmarks (`0.000 px` max hitch-free drift). |
| "68 Lean 4.35.0 proofs across 6 kernels" | **Literal (discrete specs)** — machine-checked over exact integer/`UInt32`/concrete `ListPool` models, not IEEE-754 float64 canvas rendering or Web Audio DSP. |
| "Automated WCAG 2.2 AA" | **Literal (automated scope)** — `0` axe-core violations across 4 interactive views; complements rather than replaces manual assistive-technology audits. |
| "Five living themes" / "Expressive bird emotions" | **Metaphor / visual design** — procedural Canvas 2D palettes, particle presets, and deterministic state-driven sprite expressions (`calm`/`happy`/`scared`/`determined`/`dizzy`), not AI or biology. |
| "Feather Shield" / "Serene Postcard" | **Metaphor / gameplay feature** — a boolean collision-absorption pickup and a paused canvas PNG export mode. |

## Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` / `Arrow Up` / click / tap | Flap |
| hold `Shift` / on-screen Brake | Slow descent |
| hold `Arrow Down` / on-screen Dive | Controlled dive |
| `Escape` | Pause or resume |
| `M` | Mute or unmute |
| `R` | Restart run |
| `F` | Toggle fullscreen |
| Gamepad Cross / A, or D-pad up | Flap |
| Gamepad LB or left trigger | Brake |
| Gamepad RB, right trigger, or D-pad down | Dive |
| Gamepad Start | Pause |
| Gamepad Back | Mute |
| `P` | Serene Postcard mode (calm capture) |
| `C` | Save the current frame as a PNG |

On phones and tablets, the mobile control bar stays visible near the bottom of the screen so the core
actions never depend on hidden gestures.

## Accessibility

Accessibility is part of the product, not cleanup work after the fact.

- Fully keyboard-playable core loop.
- ARIA live region for score and status updates.
- Focus-managed customizer drawer with inert background handling.
- Reduced-motion support for effects, weather, particles, and shake.
- Stronger borders under `prefers-contrast: more` and `forced-colors`.
- Skip link and semantic landmarks for faster navigation.

## Architecture At A Glance

The project is intentionally small and flat:

- `index.html` is the semantic shell, UI layout, mobile controls, drawer, and PWA metadata.
- `style.css` owns layout, theme tokens, accessibility media queries, and component styling.
- `game.js` is the module entry. `src/` holds physics, collision, input (including gamepad), audio, rendering, storage, and UI.
- `manifest.webmanifest` and `service-worker.js` provide installation and offline shell behavior.
- `tests/` holds dependency-free Node checks wired into `npm run check`, plus Playwright/axe-core E2E tests under `tests/e2e/`.

For the deeper runtime walkthrough, read [docs/architecture_master_blueprint.md](docs/architecture_master_blueprint.md).

# Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every technical, mathematical, empirical, and accessibility claim made by **GlidieBirdie v3.2.0** is listed below with its verification authority and an explicit condition that would **refute / prove us wrong** (Build Standard B04, B05, B42).

> **Epistemic boundary:** GlidieBirdie is a verified browser-game engineering project. Audited against `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (v2.6.0, 1,900 problems), it retires **0 / 1,900** open scientific or mathematical problems. This repository and its Build White Paper are not peer reviewed.

| ID | Claim | Verification Authority | What Would Prove Us Wrong (Falsification Condition) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **C1** | **Exact 60 Hz vs 144 Hz trajectory parity on hitch-free runs & demand-driven 0 FPS idle sleep** via a 60 Hz fixed-step integrator quantized on a 720 Hz integer tick grid ($\mathrm{lcm}(60,144)=720$), executing 180 steps per 3.0 s when no frame backlog is dropped (`dtTicks <= 60`), bounding hitch catch-up (`MAX_FRAME_STEPS = 5`, $\alpha \in [1/12, 1]$), terminating afterglow in 252 steps, and sleeping `rAF` when hidden or statically paused. | `lean/GlidieBirdieProofs/TimestepGrid.lean` (13 theorems, 6 kernels), `tests/determinism.mjs`, `results/benchmarks.json` (30 paired seeds: max drift `0.000 px` vs `4.783 px` naive baseline, $p_{\text{Holm}} = 3.73 \times 10^{-9}$), `results/browser-thermal.json` (`0 FPS` paused), `M03`, `M08`, `M14`. | Any hitch-free paired 60 Hz / 144 Hz run with identical quantized inputs exhibiting drift `> 0 px` or step count `!= 180` in 3.0 s, `view.alpha` outside `[1/12, 1]`, `steps > 5`, or `shouldContinueLoop()` returning `true` when hidden or statically paused. |
| **C2** | **Optimal Euclidean circle-vs-rectangle projection**, soundness under non-positive radii / degenerate rectangles / `NaN`, radius monotonicity (`0.82 * 18` runtime clearance implied by `r = 18`), and universal pipe passability (`PIPE_GAP = 184 > 5 * 36`). | `lean/GlidieBirdieProofs/CollisionGeometry.lean` (9 theorems), `tests/property-and-metamorphic.mjs` (1,000 `prop_check` trials + translation & axis-swap invariance), `tests/native-differential.mjs` (1M C11 fuzz cases), `M01`, `M02`. | Any valid `(cx, cy, cr, rx, ry, rw, rh)` violating closest-point minimality, any `cr <= 0` or `rw <= 0` returning `true`, or any valid pipe `topHeight in [60, 316]` hitting a centered bird. |
| **C3** | **Strict $O(1)$ free-list pool conservation with concrete `Nodup` index disjointness** (`PARTICLE_POOL = 220`, `WEATHER_POOL = 140`, `clearWeatherPool`) and strict 64-slot FIFO list input buffer (`INPUT_QUEUE_CAP = 64`) rejecting non-finite timestamps. | `lean/GlidieBirdieProofs/PoolAndQueue.lean` (13 theorems incl. `ListPool` & `fifoPush`), `tests/engine-test.mjs`, `tests/property-and-metamorphic.mjs`, `tests/native-differential.mjs`, 5 × 10,000-cycle pool churn benchmark (`0` violations), `M06`, `M07`. | Any spawn/reclaim/clear sequence violating `active + free === cap` or index uniqueness, or any input burst causing `getInputQueueLength() > 64` or retaining a `NaN` tick. |
| **C4** | **Injective UTC `YYYYMMDD` `dateSeed`**, exact calendar-day streak automaton (`nextDayStreak`, with `>= 1` whenever `prevStreak >= 1` or `lastDay !== today`), finite-bound-safe `clampNumber`, and allowlist-hardened `gb:` persistence surviving `QuotaExceededError` and malformed JSON. | `lean/GlidieBirdieProofs/StorageStreak.lean` (8 theorems), 366-day leap-year injectivity test, 500 `prop_check` trials, 1,500 parser fuzz cases, `QuotaExceededError` failure injection, `M04`, `M05`. | Any two distinct calendar dates colliding in `dateSeed`, any `clampNumber` returning `NaN`/`Infinity` for finite `fallback`, any streak transition violating spec, or any unallowed achievement ID surviving `readUnlockedAchievements()`. |
| **C5** | **Bit-exact 32-bit `mulberry32` parity across JS, Lean 4, and C11** (`20261125` golden vector), monotone bounded 6-point speed ramp `[1.00x, 1.18x]` saturating at score 36, Feather Shield / invincibility collision safety, sclera-clamped pupil gaze, and bounded moving-pipe vertical interpolation. | `lean/GlidieBirdieProofs/PhysicsBounds.lean` (11 theorems), `tests/native-differential.mjs`, `tests/property-and-metamorphic.mjs`, `tests/engine-test.mjs`, `M15`. | Any bit mismatch on `mulberry32(20261125)`, any score exceeding `1.18x` speed multiplier, a shielded/invincible pipe hit triggering `gameOver`, pupil offset escaping sclera (`r > 3.6`), or interpolated pipe height exiting `[lo, hi]`. |
| **C6** | **Automated WCAG 2.2 AA axe-core compliance across 4 interactive views, safe runtime media & idle power-gating**: `0` axe-core violations across initial playfield, Zen Customizer drawer, Tutorial modal, and Serene Postcard view; modal focus trap; keyboard/gamepad parity; reduced-motion game-over freeze; unlayered `prefers-reduced-transparency`; zero-volume Web Audio guard; `AudioContext.suspend()` power-gating; identical-DPR resize guard; and normalized SW cache keys. *(Automated scans complement rather than replace manual screen-reader/assistive-technology audits.)* | `tests/e2e/smoke.spec.js` (7 Playwright tests including 4-view `@axe-core/playwright` WCAG 2.2 AA scan), `tests/smoke-test.mjs`, `tests/engine-test.mjs`, `M08`, `M09`, `M10`, `M13`, `M16`. | Any axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA violation on any of the 4 scanned views, any oscillator scheduled at `volume = 0`, mute failing to suspend `AudioContext`, identical-DPR resize rebuilding sprites, any `prefers-reduced-transparency` rule placed inside `@layer`, or reloaded achievement losing `.unlocked`. |
| **C7** | **Hardened zero-dep static HTTP server** (`tools/static-server.mjs`): strict public static asset allowlist (blocking `.git/`, `.env`, `package.json`, `tools/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`), raw-URL pre-normalization dot-segment & protocol-relative `//` guard, IPv6-safe URL base, `/healthz` JSON probe, `nosniff` + `X-Frame-Options: DENY` + `Referrer-Policy`, `realpath` symlink confinement, traversal `403`, null-byte `400`, non-GET/HEAD `405`. | `tests/property-and-metamorphic.mjs` (HTTP allowlist/contract + 16x concurrency), `tests/fuzz-http-and-inputs.mjs` (500 adversarial HTTP fuzz requests), `M11`. | Any non-public path, dotfile, protocol-relative URL, traversal, or symlink escape returning `200`, any `5xx` error under fuzzing, missing security header, or failed `/healthz` under concurrent load. |
| **C8** | **100% baseline-gated surgical mutation kill score, 68-theorem 6-kernel Lean verification with live negative tamper check, C11 differential oracle + ASan/UBSan & clean static/security checks**: `16/16` planted mutants killed, `68/68` Lean theorems verified across 6 kernels (19 zero-axiom + live negative tamper rejection), 1M C11 oracle fuzz cases, `12/12` BibTeX citations resolved, `0` duplicate keys/self-comparisons, `0` retired brand tokens, `0` CodeQL alerts, `0` npm CVEs. | `scripts/mutation-test.mjs` (`16/16`), `lean/scripts/verify-negative-kernel.sh`, `tests/native-differential.mjs`, `scripts/check-citations.mjs` (`12/12`), `tests/static-checks.mjs`, `tests/brand-guard.mjs`, `tests/license-guard.mjs`, `tests/link-guard.mjs`, `npm audit`, CodeQL CI. | Any surviving mutant or runner error in `scripts/mutation-test.mjs`, any accepted tampered proof in `verify-negative-kernel.sh`, any C11 differential or ASan/UBSan failure, any CodeQL alert on `main`, or any failure in `npm run check` / `npm run fuzz`. |

# Limitations and Real-vs-Metaphor Boundaries (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

This document states explicitly what **GlidieBirdie v3.2.0** does **not** prove, guarantee, or solve (Build Standard B41).

## 1. Epistemic Scope & Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas

- **0 / 1,900 Mega-Atlas problems retired:** GlidieBirdie is a deterministic browser game and software-verification artifact, not a mathematical conjecture proof. None of the 1,900 open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` are solved or retired by this repository.
- **Not peer reviewed:** Neither the repository nor the Build White Paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_glidiebirdie_deterministic_browser_architecture.pdf`) has undergone external journal or conference peer review. Correctness rests solely on reproducible mechanical checks (Lean 4.35.0 kernel + automated test suites).

## 2. Formal-to-Runtime Modeling Gaps (Lean 4 vs JavaScript)

- **Discrete integers vs IEEE-754 float64:** The 68 Lean 4.35.0 theorems verify exact integer, `UInt32`, boolean, and list-backed specifications (`GlidieBirdieProofs/Spec.lean`). The browser runtime executes JavaScript IEEE-754 double-precision floating-point arithmetic for bird velocity, drag (`Math.pow`), canvas rendering, and `msToTicks` rounding. Float behavior is tested empirically (`tests/determinism.mjs`, `tests/property-and-metamorphic.mjs`, `tests/fuzz-http-and-inputs.mjs`, `tests/native-differential.mjs`, `results/benchmarks.json`), not formally proved over $\mathbb{R}$ or IEEE-754.
- **Pure list model vs mutable JS arrays:** `PoolAndQueue.lean` certifies BOTH abstract slot-count conservation (`PoolState`) and concrete index uniqueness/disjointness (`ListPool` with `Nodup` and `fifoPush`); mutable in-place JS array mutation and object-field recycling in `particlePool`/`weatherPool` are verified empirically by `tests/engine-test.mjs`, the 5 × 10,000-cycle pool churn benchmark, and the 1,000,000-case C11 differential oracle fuzzer (`native/glidiebirdie_oracle.c`).
- **Canvas & Web Audio side effects:** Visual rendering (`src/render.js`) and Web Audio DSP synthesis (`src/audio.js`) are verified via Node stubs, Playwright browser runs, and manual inspection rather than formal semantics.

## 3. Platform & Security Limitations

- **No `file://` execution:** Because `game.js` uses native ES2022 modules (`<script type="module">`), modern browsers block module loading over `file://` due to CORS. Serve locally over HTTP (`npm run serve`) or via HTTPS (GitHub Pages).
- **Client-side persistence is user-modifiable:** `localStorage` (`gb:*` keys) is strictly local convenience storage. A player can edit their own scores or achievements in browser DevTools; no tamper-proof leaderboard or server-side anti-cheat exists or is claimed.
- **GitHub Pages CSP header ceiling:** `index.html` enforces a strict `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">` (`default-src 'self'`), but `frame-ancestors` is a response-header-only directive ignored in `<meta>` tags. GitHub Pages does not expose custom HTTP response headers (the local `tools/static-server.mjs` does emit `X-Frame-Options: DENY`).
- **Windows local multi-kernel sandbox:** On Windows, `lake build`, `VerifyAxioms.lean`, `leanchecker`, and `leanchecker-paranoid` run locally, while `lake comparator --paranoid` requires Linux `bubblewrap` namespaces and executes cleanly in the Ubuntu GitHub Actions CI job (`lean-6kernel`).

## 4. Real vs Metaphor

- Visual terms in the game and docs (*"calm"*, *"zen"*, *"living bird"*, *"breathing"*, *"emotion"*, *"Afterglow"*) describe purely cosmetic Canvas 2D sprite expressions, easing curves, and UI copy. No biological simulation, emotional state, or clinical relaxation/therapeutic efficacy is claimed.

<!-- END LIMITATIONS.md -->

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

Any independent engineer or researcher can replicate every formal, empirical, and browser claim in **GlidieBirdie v3.2.0** from a clean clone without special hardware, API keys, or cloud credentials (Build Standard B43, B44).

## Prerequisites

- **Node.js** `>= 20` (tested on Node `v22` in CI and `v25.8.2` locally)
- **Lean 4** `v4.35.0` via `elan` (`lean/lean-toolchain` pins `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`; zero Mathlib download required)
- **Tectonic** `>= 0.15` (optional, for recompiling `paper/main.tex` and `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`)
- **Playwright Chromium** (`npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, optional for browser E2E/axe-core tests)

## Step-by-Step Clean-Clone Replication

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie.git
cd glidiebirdie

# 1. Verify tracked SHA-256 manifests BEFORE regenerating host-specific benchmarks
sha256sum -c data/MANIFEST.sha256
sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256

npm ci

# 2. Core syntax, static, brand, link, license, 12/12 citations, 81 engine, 8 property/contract, determinism, and smoke suites
npm run check

# 3. Structured adversarial fuzzing (2,000 JS parser & HTTP static-server cases) + C11 differential oracle (1,000,000 fuzz cases)
npm run fuzz
npm run test:native

# 4. Baseline-gated surgical mutation testing (16/16 mutants must be KILLED)
npm run mutate

# 5. 30-seed counterbalanced 60 Hz vs 144 Hz determinism, 5,400 pure-step & 5x10k pool-churn benchmarks
#    (Note: rewrites results/benchmarks.json with your local CPU/OS timings.)
npm run benchmark

# 6. Report-only ESLint & strict TypeScript (checkJs + WebWorker) checks
npm run lint
npm run typecheck

# 7. Browser E2E + 4-view WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility tests (7 Playwright + axe-core tests)
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
npm run test:browser

# 8. Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal core (68 theorems, zero sorry, zero Mathlib, 6-kernel comparator + negative tamper test)
(
  cd lean
  lake build
  lake build Challenge
  lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
  lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
  lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution
  # On Linux with bubblewrap installed:
  lake check --paranoid
  lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
)
# On Linux with bubblewrap installed — live negative kernel tamper test (must exit 0 after rejecting sorry):
bash lean/scripts/verify-negative-kernel.sh

# 9. Build White Paper source AND standalone arXiv tarball verification
mkdir -p paper/build /tmp/arxiv-verify
tectonic -X compile paper/main.tex --outdir paper/build --keep-intermediates
tar -xzf dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz -C /tmp/arxiv-verify
tectonic -X compile /tmp/arxiv-verify/main.tex --outdir /tmp/arxiv-verify

# 10. Build Standard v1.2.0 self-audit
pwsh scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .    # or: bash scripts/audit-repo.sh .
```

## Expected Replication Criteria

1. `sha256sum -c data/MANIFEST.sha256` and `sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256` pass cleanly on a fresh clone before regenerating `results/benchmarks.json`.
2. `npm run check` exits `0` with `12/12` citations resolved, `81/81` engine assertions, `8/8` property/metamorphic/HTTP contract suites, `180` identical hitch-free steps at 60 Hz and 144 Hz, and `0` static/brand/link/license failures.
3. `npm run fuzz` exits `0` across `2,000` adversarial JS cases (`1,500` parser/engine + `500` HTTP) with `0` crashes and `0` leaks, and `npm run test:native` compiles `native/glidiebirdie_oracle.c` with `-std=c11 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror` and completes `1,000,000` fuzz cases with `0` failures and bit-for-bit JS/Lean parity.
4. `npm run mutate` exits `0` after baseline verification with `16/16 (100.0%) killed, 0 survived, 0 runner errors`.
5. `results/benchmarks.json` reports `fixed_step_60hz_on_720hz_grid_max_drift_px.max === 0`, `paired_wins_fixed_over_variable === 30`, `exact_sign_test_p <= 1e-8`, `pure_simulation_step_latency_us.median < 2000`, `individual_step_budget_violations_60hz === 0`, and `conservation_violations === 0`.
6. `VerifyAxioms.lean` emits `68` lines strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (`19` zero-axiom, `0` `sorryAx`, `0` `ofReduceBool`, `0` custom axioms), `leanchecker` / `leanchecker-paranoid` / `lake comparator --paranoid` exit `0`, and `lean/scripts/verify-negative-kernel.sh` exits `0` (proving tampered proofs are rejected).
7. Both `paper/main.tex` and the extracted standalone `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz` compile cleanly via Tectonic with `0` warnings.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->

# GlidieBirdie — Architecture

A precise, diagram-backed walkthrough of how the game is built. Companion to
[`architecture_master_blueprint.md`](architecture_master_blueprint.md) (narrative) and
[`DATA-MODEL.md`](DATA-MODEL.md) (persistence ERD).

## 1. One-paragraph summary

GlidieBirdie is a **zero-dependency, canvas-rendered browser game** plus a tiny PWA
shell. There is no build step, no framework, and no backend. `index.html` is the semantic shell,
`style.css` is all presentation, and `game.js` loads native ES modules from `src/`. A fixed 60 Hz
simulation (720 Hz tick grid, so 60 Hz and 144 Hz land on the same steps) advances a single mutable
`state` object; rendering interpolates between steps. A `service-worker.js` caches the shell, including
every module. Everything is delivered as static files on GitHub Pages.

## 2. Component map

```mermaid
graph TD
  subgraph Static Delivery (GitHub Pages)
    HTML[index.html<br/>semantic shell + DOM contract]
    CSS[style.css<br/>layout · themes · a11y]
    JS[game.js + src/*.js<br/>native ES modules]
    SW[service-worker.js<br/>offline shell]
    MAN[manifest.webmanifest<br/>install metadata]
  end
  HTML -->|type=module| JS
  HTML -->|link| CSS
  HTML -->|link| MAN
  JS -->|register| SW
  JS -->|render| CANVAS[(canvas#game)]
  JS -->|persist| LS[(localStorage gb:*)]
  JS -->|synthesize| WA[(Web Audio graph)]
```

## 3. Engine internal structure (`game.js` + `src/*.js`)

The engine is organized into focused native ES modules under `src/` (no bundler):

```mermaid
graph LR
  CFG[src/config.js<br/>frozen tunables] --> STATE[src/state.js<br/>single source of truth]
  STATE --> UPD{src/physics.js}
  UPD --> PHYS[bird / emotion / eyes]
  UPD --> PIPES[pipes / spawn / cull]
  UPD --> FX[particles / weather pools]
  UPD --> COLL[src/collision.js]
  STATE --> DRAW{src/render.js}
  DRAW --> CACHE[sprite / sky / pipe caches]
  DRAW --> HUD[score / HUD / postcard / modals]
  LOOP[src/loop.js<br/>fixed 60 Hz on 720 Hz grid] --> UPD
  LOOP --> DRAW
  INPUT[src/input.js + input-queue.js] --> STATE
  STORAGE[src/storage.js] --> STATE
```

**Module boundaries:** `src/config.js` → `src/rng.js` → `src/storage.js` → `src/timestep.js` / `src/input-queue.js` → `src/state.js` → `src/dom.js` / `src/haptics.js` / `src/hooks.js` → `src/audio.js` → `src/collision.js` → `src/physics.js` → `src/render.js` → `src/achievements.js` → `src/ui.js` → `src/session.js` → `src/input.js` → `src/loop.js` → `src/main.js` (loaded by `game.js`).

## 4. The frame loop (data flow per frame)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant rAF as requestAnimationFrame
  participant L as loop()
  participant S as stepSimulation()
  participant U as update()
  participant D as draw()
  rAF->>L: timestamp
  L->>L: pollGamepad() · map ms to 720 Hz tick grid
  loop up to MAX_FRAME_STEPS (5) per frame
    L->>S: step at 1/60 s (12 ticks, dt=1, dtSec=1/60)
    S->>S: snapshotPrev() · consumeInputs() · syncLocomotion()
    S->>U: if phase==play && !paused (or gameOver visual decay)
    U->>U: updateNearestPipeCache() · updateBird() · updateEmotion()
    U->>U: updatePipes() · updateShieldBubbles()
    U->>U: spawn/update weather · particles · checkCollisions()
  end
  L->>D: view.alpha clamped to [0, 1] · draw()
  D->>D: interpolated world (shake-wrapped) → HUD → modal / postcard
  L->>rAF: schedule next
```

**Invariant:** Gameplay physics only advance during active play in exact 1/60 s steps (`dt = 1`, `dtSec = 1/60`) on a 720 Hz grid; `gameOver` continues decaying shake/flashes/particles and the afterglow timer without advancing gameplay. Capping hitches at `MAX_FRAME_STEPS = 5` and clamping `view.alpha` to `[0, 1]` prevents collision tunneling and extrapolation jumps.

## 5. Rendering model

- One global transform matrix; `ctx.save()/restore()` strictly balanced.
- **Painter's algorithm:** background → pipes → shield bubbles → ground → bird trail → bird → bird shield → weather → particles → score → meters → flashes → vignette → FPS, then (outside the shake transform) the modal panel.
- **Screen shake** translates the whole world render but is applied *before* the modal, so game-over text never shakes.
- **Sprite caching:** the bird is pre-rendered to an offscreen canvas per `(theme, emotion)` — 25 small canvases — so the per-frame cost is one `drawImage` plus the dynamic wing/eyes overlay.
- **DPR awareness:** the canvas backing store is `420×640 × devicePixelRatio`; all drawing is in logical units via `setTransform(dpr,…)`.

## 6. Audio architecture

```mermaid
graph LR
  SFX_OSC[SFX oscillators] --> MG[masterGain]
  MUSIC_OSC[Music oscillators] --> MUG[musicGain] --> MG
  MG --> LP[lowpass]
  MG --> RV[convolver reverb]
  LP --> OUT[(destination)]
  RV --> WET[reverb wet gain] --> OUT
  SCHED[lookahead scheduler<br/>audio sample clock] --> MUSIC_OSC
```

Procedural only (no audio files). Music is scheduled on the **audio clock** (drift-free), routes through a dedicated `musicGain` bus so music fades never duck SFX, and the whole graph is lazily built on the first user gesture.

## 7. Persistence

All state persists to `localStorage` under a `gb:` namespace via a single `SK` key map, behind guarded
read/write helpers (clamp + NaN fallback + try/catch). A one-time `migrateLegacyStorage()` carries
pre-rebrand keys forward. The service-worker cache name is tied to `package.json` version. See
[`DATA-MODEL.md`](DATA-MODEL.md) for the full entity diagram.

## 8. Boot sequence

```text
onDprChange(rebuildSpriteCaches) → configureCanvasForDPR() → updateDerivedPhysics() → resetGame()
→ bindDrawerControls() → bindMobileControls() → bindTutorial()
→ registerServiceWorker() → syncUiState() → attach toolbar listeners
→ requestAnimationFrame(loop)
```

Linear, idempotent, and defensive (every DOM ref is optional-chained, so a missing element no-ops).

## 9. Key invariants (do not break)

| Invariant | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `dt` clamped to `DT_MAX` | Collision tunneling-proof at any frame rate/preset |
| `dtSec` coupled to `dt` on zero-elapsed frames | Prevents `time` vs `elapsedSec` drift / cooldown stalls |
| Squash/stretch is visual-only | Hitbox stays predictable |
| Exponential decay uses `Math.pow(base, dt)` | Frame-rate-independent drag/shake |
| All storage via guarded helpers + `SK` map | Corruption-safe, namespaced, migratable |
| `globalAlpha` reset after each alpha pass | No accidental global translucency |
| Audio/storage wrapped in try/catch | Non-essential systems never crash a frame |

## 10. Extension points (how to add things safely)

- **New theme:** add a `THEME_TABLE` entry + a `body.theme-*` block in CSS + a music entry. Table-driven, no branching.
- **New tunable:** add to frozen `CONFIG`; never inline a magic number.
- **New persisted value:** add a key to `SK`, read via a guarded helper, document it in `DATA-MODEL.md`.
- **New effect:** spawn through the existing pools; never allocate in the hot loop.
- **New gate:** add a check to `npm run check`; if it touches `.github/`/`tests/`, expect the Guardrail check.

## 11. Constraints (architectural guardrails)

- No build step, no runtime dependencies, no backend, no remote assets/fonts/CDN.
- Do not add a bundler. Keep `style.css` as one file. New engine code belongs in `src/`.
- Keep the service worker tiny and app-shell-focused.
- `main` is PR-gated; every change flows branch → PR → CI → auto-merge.

<!-- END docs/ARCHITECTURE.md -->

<!-- BEGIN lean/README.md -->
================================================================================
FILE: lean/README.md
================================================================================

# GlidieBirdie v3.2.0 — Pure Lean 4.35.0 Formal Core

Zero-Mathlib, zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 (`module` system) formalization certifying **68 theorems** (59 core invariants + 9 constructive adversarial refutations; 19 zero-axiom theorems) across seven modules covering the discrete mathematical invariants of GlidieBirdie's browser engine (`src/`).

## Modules

| Module | Theorems | Runtime Source Covered |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/Spec.lean` | — | Pure shared definitions (zero proofs, zero `sorry`) |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/TimestepGrid.lean` | 13 | `src/timestep.js`, `src/loop.js` (720 Hz LCM grid, 60/144 Hz parity, hitch-free `dt <= 60` proof, alpha clamp & positivity, 252-step afterglow, idle scheduler liveness & thermal sleep) |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/CollisionGeometry.lean` | 9 | `src/collision.js` (closest-point optimality, non-positive guard, conservative radius monotonicity, universal pipe clearance) |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/StorageStreak.lean` | 8 | `src/storage.js`, `src/rng.js` (`nextDayStreak`, `dateSeed` injectivity, `clampNumber` bounds) |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/PoolAndQueue.lean` | 13 | `src/physics.js`, `src/input-queue.js` (abstract & concrete `Nodup` free-list pool conservation, `clearWeatherPool`, 64-cap FIFO list queue) |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/PhysicsBounds.lean` | 11 | `src/physics.js`, `src/rng.js` (6-point ramp `[1.00×, 1.18×]`, shield hit safety, `mulberry32` 32-bit golden vectors, pupil sclera clamp, moving-pipe lerp bounds) |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/NonVacuity.lean` | 5 | Concrete witnesses proving every hypothesis bundle (including concrete `ListPool`) is satisfiable |
| `GlidieBirdieProofs/AdversarialTests.lean` | 9 | Constructive false-variant refutations proving guards, caps, sclera clamp, and preconditions are sharp |

## Local Verification Commands

```bash
cd lean
lake build
lake build Challenge
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution
# On Linux with bubblewrap installed (also run in GitHub Actions CI):
lake check --paranoid
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd .. && bash lean/scripts/verify-negative-kernel.sh
```
